channel.title: Eastern Daily Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Eastern Daily Press (edp24.co.uk)

item.title: Italian restaurant launches unique twist on British classic
item.description: An independent restaurant in St Andrews Hill is launching an 'authentic' Italian afternoon tea, which can be enjoyed with Aperol spritz, on Mother's Day.

item.title: Could Norfolk leader's 'bastard' outburst cost county millions?
item.description: The Norfolk County Council leader's outspoken attack on the government - in which she called a minister a "bastard" - could end up costing the region millions of pounds, her critics claim.

item.title: Home STILL 'freezing' a week on from sudden 24-hour clearance
item.description: Tenants left with no beds at a home in Unthank Road after it was suddenly cleared out by the District Property Limited, have slammed the owner, Clear Summers.

item.title: Teacher left quadriplegic after fall married in hospital days before his death
item.description: A much-loved former Langley School teacher married his partner in a Norfolk hospital just days before his death, following an accident that left him paralysed.

item.title: Master butcher celebrates 40 years at family-run shop
item.description: Vinny Mudd has celebrated 40 years of service at WJSeppings in Hungate, Beccles after starting as a teenager.

item.title: Leader's moment of contrived drama could cost Norfolk dearly
item.description: Because of her frustrations with the government, Kay Mason Billig is ready to throw away millions of pounds of government investment promised to Norfolk and the chance to overhaul our outdated, inefficient, expensive system of local government.

item.title: Golf club to celebrate special milestone by turning clock back to Edwardian times
item.description: A golf club will celebrate its 125th anniversary by turning the clock back to Edwardian times.

item.title: 20-year-old man walks to police station with knife after death threat
item.description: Sardam Mahamad pleaded guilty to carrying a knife in Great Yarmouth following "threats to kill him".

item.title: Homes bid for Norfolk town refused after flurry of objections from locals
item.description: Plans to build up to four new homes on a site in Dereham have been thrown out.

item.title: Great Yarmouth pottery legend honoured in major new exhibition
item.description: A major exhibition of commemorative tankards by much‑loved Great Yarmouth potter and artist Ernie Childs is to go on show at Pakefield’s Ferini Art Gallery.
